# MM-P2-L2-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance and verification tasks for the Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) used in the P2 line. It covers the austenitizing setpoint verification, thermocouple calibration schedule, general furnace checks, and the acceptance criteria required to return the furnace to production. This manual is intended for maintenance technicians and heat treat operators and supplements operating procedures SOP-P2-L2-02 and SOP-P2-L2-05. See also MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 for parts and spares information.

Background and rationale
The stability of the austenitizing temperature directly affects microstructure and dimensional repeatability of ring-rolled components. Thermocouple accuracy and sensor placement are critical to achieving consistent metallurgical results. The procedures in this manual are structured to verify that the furnace reaches and holds the specified austenitizing setpoint and that thermocouples are within calibration tolerance before production cycles. Where calibration or repairs are required, documented evidence is retained to demonstrate process control.

Tools and equipment
- Calibrated reference thermocouple and readout compatible with furnace controllers
- Portable temperature datalogger capable of mapping chamber temperatures
- Hand tools and safety gear as required by SOP-P2-L2-02
- Replacement thermocouple assemblies listed in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1
- Lockout/tagout kit as required by SOP-P2-L2-05

Procedure
Pre-work verification
- Review last maintenance record and calibration certificate for EQ-P2-L2-HT02. Confirm that no work is in progress on the associated line and that production is scheduled around the planned maintenance window as coordinated with operations.
- Apply lockout/tagout per SOP-P2-L2-05 and confirm isolation of energy sources.

Thermocouple calibration and check
- Install the calibrated reference thermocouple into the furnace at the representative load position used during production. Ensure probe entry follows manufacturer routing and strain relief practices referenced in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1.
- Run a controlled heat cycle to ramp the furnace to the austenitizing setpoint and hold to allow chamber stabilization.
- Compare the furnace controller readout to the reference thermocouple at stabilized condition. The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 40 days. Ensure that calibration is current before authorizing production.
- If reference readings show drift outside allowable tolerance per MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, tag the thermocouple assembly for replacement and proceed to the replacement steps.

Austenitizing setpoint verification
- Set the furnace controller to the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) as specified at 855 °C.
- Allow the furnace to stabilize at that setpoint with the standardized load or ballast specified in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 to reproduce production thermal mass conditions.
- Use the portable datalogger to map temperature uniformity across the load zone. Record the controller setpoint, controller readout, and datalogger measurements in the maintenance record.
- If the furnace cannot reach or maintain 855 °C within process tolerances defined in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1, escalate to the supervisor and schedule the corrective action specified in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1.

Mechanical and electrical checks
- Inspect furnace door seals, chamber lining, and heat elements for signs of localized damage or degradation. Document condition and retain images in the maintenance record.
- Verify control wiring connections at the thermocouple terminal block and controller input for secure terminations. Replace or tighten per MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 if corrosion or looseness is observed.
- Confirm the functionality of alarm indicators and interlocks per SOP-P2-L2-02.

Records and examples
- Maintain a maintenance log entry for each calibration and verification activity. The log must include equipment id EQ-P2-L2-HT02, date of action, technician name, reference thermocouple serial, controller readout, datalogger output files, and any corrective action performed.
- Example record entries should include the controller setpoint, reference thermocouple peak reading, and remarks on uniformity mapping. Store digital temperature maps and calibration certificates attached to the log in the document control system and reference MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 for file naming conventions.

Acceptance criteria
- Thermocouple calibration is valid and within tolerance per MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1. The thermocouple calibration interval for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 40 days; a current calibration certificate must be on file.
- Furnace is capable of reaching and maintaining the austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) at 855 °C with thermal uniformity across the load zone as specified in MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1.
- All mechanical inspections show no damage that would compromise process control. Electrical connections and controller inputs pass continuity and integrity checks per SOP-P2-L2-02.
- Associated alarms and interlocks function as designed. Any deviation must be documented and corrected prior to returning equipment to service.

Disposition and return to service
- If acceptance criteria are met, remove lockout/tagout and notify operations that EQ-P2-L2-HT02 is available for production. Attach completed maintenance record to the equipment history file.
- If corrective actions were required, include descriptions of parts replaced and reference MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 parts used. Hold a supervisory review before re-issuing the equipment to production.

Related documents
- MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1
- SOP-P2-L2-02
- SOP-P2-L2-05

Records to keep
- Calibration certificate for reference thermocouple
- Datalogger temperature maps and raw files
- Maintenance log entry for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 including images and corrective action notes
- Replacement part receipts referenced to MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1

End of document.
